messages:
maria: quick sync — onboarding zeta13b weights. HF source already published, but when I point the registry at s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta13b/v1 the model-server fails with tokenizer pad len mismatch. can someone confirm the mirrored shard layout and ACLs?
ajay: passing this to the registry owners — @tomas do you know if the mirror job preserved the tokenizer.json file and the shard keys?
tomas: i started the mirror yesterday night with sa-model-sync. logs look fine but i did see one 403 on a specific shard during the final copy, fixed now. full path: s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta13b/v1/weights/0001-of-0016\.tokenizer.json? (weird filename)
li: that filename sounds off — tokenizer should be tokenizer.json at root, not under weights and definitely not with a dot before token name. could be the hf->s3 conversion queuing script adding extra path segments.
maria: hmm ok that explains mismatch. tokenizer loader expects top-level tokenizer.json and the serving config points to registry://zeta13b/v1/tokenizer.json. when it finds .tokenizer.json it treats as unknown format and falls back to byte-level, causing pad len mismatch.
ajay: can we do quick fix: create a presigned copy of the correct tokenizer at the top-level and update the registry manifest? i can patch the manifest if someone provides correct file.
tomas: i pulled the tokenizer from HF and uploaded a sanitized copy to s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta13b/v1/tokenizer.json and updated manifest entry 'files.tokenizer' -> tokenizer.json. pushed as registry manifest v1.0.1.
maria: thanks. can you also add checksum? CI checks validate sha256 in manifest. what did you compute?
tomas: sha256: 6c1f2a9d4f7b8e3a2c0d1f5b9aef3b77c4a2d9b8e5f6c1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0. updated manifest.
li: quick note — the mirror pipeline strips metadata by default; we should change the job to preserve 'tokenizer.json' name. filing a tiny change in infra repo. i'll do a quick PR.
ajay: PR link?
li: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/compare/keep-tokenizer-name — small lambda that rewrites object key mapping before copy.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: mirror-job (mirror-zeta13b) completed with 1 warning (tokenizer key mismatch) — action taken: copied sanitized tokenizer to top-level.
artifact-bot: registry:manifest updated for zeta13b v1 -> v1.0.1 (checksum verified)
maria: re-running serving smoke now. will ping when done.
(5m later) maria: smoke done — model loads, tokenization looks correct, pad mismatch gone. thanks!
ajay: can we add a preflight check to the onboarding checklist: ensure tokenizer file present at manifest.files.tokenizer and sha256 matches?
li: good call. i'll add a checklist item and a failing CI job that rejects manifest if tokenizer is missing or filename not exactly 'tokenizer.json'.
tomas: also adding an alert when sa-model-sync returns any 4xx during mirror, so we catch partial copies earlier.
maria: perfect. last ask — can someone add a quick note in the onboarding doc about registry path expectations (hf -> s3 mapping) so Solutions Eng doesn't run into this again?
ajay: i'll add a short blurb and a sample presign command we use for manual copy:```aws s3 cp tokenizer.json s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta13b/v1/tokenizer.json --profile sa-model-sync && aws s3api put-object-tagging --bucket redwood-artifacts --key "zeta13b/v1/tokenizer.json" --tagging "TagSet=[{Key=origin,Value=hf}]"```
li: thanks — i'll also add a tiny lint in registry uploader: reject keys that start with '.' or have unexpected subdirs for tokenizer.
maria: ok closing this thread — all good on our side. :tada:
